children: Aethir's ACCELERATE program has secured 10 mid-sized data center sites with up to 20MW of capacity across the US and Europe, moving the DePIN network into physical AI infrastructure while it continues operating its distributed compute services.

The buildout targets up to $700M in contracts by the end of 2026 and $2B+ at full buildout, giving ATH a concrete capacity expansion thesis tied to enterprise compute demand. Secured capacity of this size supports serving dedicated AI workloads directly. The contract figures are stated targets rather than booked revenue, so execution on securing tenants and energizing the sites will determine how much of the pipeline converts.
Aethir ACCELERATE has already secured 10 mid-sized data center sites, with up to 20MW, across the US and Europe.
The data centers will bring up to $700M in contracts by the end of 2026, and $2B+ at full buildout.

title: Aethir: ACCELERATE secures 10 data center sites for physical AI infrastructure - 15 Sep 2026
